formulation: tablet and tablet for oral suspension

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 213137 ACCELERATED APPROVAL ... OXBRYTA (voxelotor) tablets ... treatment of sickle cell disease in adults and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older (signed 11/25/2019)

launch_evidence.quote: Oxbryta and fully launched with a deployed sales force in December 2019

series_start_reason: GBT began shipping Oxbryta in December 2019 (FY2019 10-K: 'Our product sales consist of U.S. sales of Oxbryta, which we began shipping to customers in December 2019. Prior to December 2019, we had no product sales'); 2019Q4 is the first row.
series_end_reason: Pfizer announced the voluntary withdrawal of all lots of Oxbryta in September 2024 (release footnote to the 2024Q4 row). The fourth-quarter 2024 release (2025-02-04) prints the last Oxbryta row (8 worldwide, 2 U.S.); the first-quarter 2025 release (2025-04-29) and later releases print no Oxbryta row.

unreported_quarters.2022Q3: Ownership change Global Blood Therapeutics to Pfizer. GBT's last periodic report is the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2022 (filed 2022-08-08); Pfizer completed the acquisition on 2022-10-05 (GBT filed Form 25-NSE on 2022-10-05 and Form 15-12G on 2022-10-17 and no 10-Q for the third quarter), and Pfizer's third-quarter 2022 release and 10-Q print no Oxbryta figure (its 2023-10-31 release prints a dash for the 2022Q3 prior-year column). No document gives a 2022Q3 figure.

notes: U.S. scope chosen because GBT's 'Product sales, net' consists of U.S. sales of Oxbryta (FY2019 10-K) and Pfizer's table prints a U.S. column on the same row; the Pfizer rows use that U.S. column. Pfizer's worldwide column is 73, 71, 77, 85, 96, 84, 92, 17, 8 for 2022Q4-2024Q4 (international 1-6; negative in 2024Q3 after returns). Pfizer's 2022Q4 figure covers the period from the 2022-10-05 acquisition. GBT amounts are printed in thousands. Oxbryta (tablets for oral suspension, December 2021) is part of the same brand line. Sums: GBT 2020 quarters 123.803 = twelve months 2020 123,803; 2021 194.749 = 194,749; Pfizer 2024 worldwide 84+92+17+8 = 201 printed twelve-month 201.
